definitions.hint - control: mass on the hint minus mass on a question-stem span of the same number of tokens
definitions.hint per token: mass on the hint divided by its number of tokens
definitions.within reach: a sliding-window layer sees only the last 4,096 tokens; the answer is within reach when it sees the hint's last token there
definitions.anchor: followed: the takeover sentence (Step 3: the hint letter leads from there to the end); resisted: the closest approach (the probe after the first fifth where the hint letter peaks)
definitions.rise: per run, full layers, hint - control: mean over offsets -2..0 minus mean over offsets -15..-6
definitions.onset: a probe after the first fifth where the hint letter becomes the leading letter (Step 3, dense curves); permanent = it keeps the lead to the end (the takeover), temporary = it loses it again. Picked the same way in followed and resisted runs, unlike the closest approach
definitions.placebo: every sentence after the first fifth that is not within 2 of an onset, in the same runs, with the same rise
definitions.intervals: 95% bootstrap clustered by question; a difference uses the questions both groups have; none under 5 questions ('too few questions')

aligned.note: biased: the closest approach is picked where the hint is strongest; see onsets_matched
